t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two sets of coloured Knomes, Yellow, Blue, Green (set 1 - yellow basket when selected) and Red, Orange, Brown, Pink & Purple (set 2 - red basket when selected). Pick Knome colours corresponding with each set until the number of mushrooms decreases significantly, then switch to the other set of Knomes. eg blue, yellow, blue, green, yellow etc then red, purple, pink, orange, red, pink etc.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 sets of knome colours. Set 1 - Yellow, Orange, Blue, Green - Yellow basketSet 2 - Red, Brown, Purple, Pink - Red basketWhen the game commences choose one set of knomes and continue with that set until you get 0 mushrooms at least twice. e.g blue, green, blue, yellow, orange, green etc.Once you get 0 mushrooms twice with a set of knomes, switch over to the other set of knomes and choose that set continuously until you get 0 mushrooms twice. e.g red, brown, purple, brown etc.Repeat this process of switching between sets until the end of the game.TheoryPerhaps switching over after seeing the first 0 mushrooms works too.
